The goldens are derived from SKILL.md's rules by hand; the iteration-24 cold-agent run (33/33) predates the 22-24 Oct roster change, and the iteration-25 cold-agent run (6 fresh agents, 27 Oct) scored 35/36 on the first pass; e1 missed once (long-context tag dropped) and passed on two further fresh agents. g1, j1, n1, r1, t1, w2, w3 changed goldens; p2 and ef1 are new. `python grade_routing.py --selftest --results-dir /tmp/x` proves the grader and the goldens agree. Effort rule: D>=2 -> max on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash / GLM-5.3-Flash. The iteration-20 (Codex) set is archived under archive/iteration-20-codex/routing/.
